notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1148
notes.notes:
[p]- Papa Prestigio Rank 6 has been updated. 
- Due to changes in the order and effects of Papa Prestigio, the chosen options have been refreshed. (Design Score remains intact.) Therefore, if you were previously benefiting from Papa Prestigio effects, we kindly ask you to select your desired effect again. 
- The duration of Papa Prestigio’s Power Surge effect has been reduced to 15 seconds. Since the effect had been incorrectly applied for 30 seconds due to a bug (instead of the intended 20 seconds), you may feel the reduction more strongly. 
- When selecting the Cvex Capacity buff in Papa Prestigio, the number of additional Cvex granted has been increased from 1 to 2. 
- Rank 6 interior items have been added. About 71 autumn-themed items are now available across the categories Light, Furniture, Entertainment, Neon Signs, Wall Art, Food Replica, and Theme. In addition, the Food Replica category and related props have been newly added. 
- Installed props now remain in the list, making it easier to place the same prop repeatedly.[/p]

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1144
notes.notes:
- Fixed Killer Clown’s hitbox so it no longer blocks weak points when attacked from the side or rear 
- Translation adjustments 
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1142
notes.notes:
- Added a new installment gear: Magic Powder.
- Added a contract to obtain Magic Powder.
- Added Bandit Record and Achievements for Magic Powder.
- Added a Shuffle function to the jukebox.
- Improved the behavior of the progress bar for abnormal states.
- Fixed a UI bug in Albert's Workshop.
- Fixed a bug where damage increased when equipping the Predator Scope.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1138
notes.notes:
- Fixed the issues with the Albert Workshop UI.
- Radiant Nomad has been slightly nerfed.
- Fixed translation errors.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1136
notes.notes: - Fixed an issue where bosses did not drop Time Stones upon death.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1135
notes.notes:
- Added a new Secondary Weapon: Vital Injector. Accordingly, Bandit Record, Steam, and Epic Store Achievements have also been updated.
- Enabled Frame Generation. Restarting the game is required to change the algorithm. This feature is still experimental and may be unstable.
- Bosses now drop Time Stones.
- Fixed some translation errors in German.
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1128
notes.notes:
[p]- Fixed an issue where joining sessions with voice chat enabled on other platforms could cause a crash. Only those sessions are disabled for now; sessions without voice chat can still be joined.
- Adjusted Frankie and Stankie so they are more susceptible to headshots.
- Slightly increased the total ammo for the base Sniper Rifle.[/p]

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1125
notes.notes:
- The results screen now displays damage dealt.
- The total ammo of the two Sniper Rifles has been slightly increased.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1121
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where the stamina increase effect from pizza buffs was not applied correctly.
- Fixed translation errors.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1117
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Reduced the heat generated per shot for Fatemaker. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Hemicrypt could not be targeted when using the Predator Scope. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the third strike of Titan Maul was always applied with double damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Leave Party behavior to return players to the Lobby Restaurant instead of the start screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1114
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where the player would crash after returning to the lobby.
- Adjusted Fatemaker to overheat more quickly.
- Improved visibility in some UI elements.
- Fixed translation errors.
- Adjusted so enemy sounds from behind can be heard more clearly.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1112
notes.notes:
- Increased the waiting time per customer in Sushi Showdown.
- Slightly increased the reload times for Radiant Nomad and Nebula MKV.
- Fixed an issue where purchasing all modifications for the Rapid Raptor would not unlock the achievement.
- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck on certain terrain in Restaurant from Nowhere.
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1110
notes.notes:
- Adjusted higher difficulties to drop more time stones.
- Fixed an issue where purchasing all Rapid Raptor Modifications did not unlock the achievement.
- Significantly reduced the warm-up time for Fatemaker’s attacks.
- Greatly increased the damage of the Frag Grenade.
- The multiplayer window now displays which time stone is dropped in the current room.
- Changed Ducalis in Difficulty 4 from Full Armored to Half Armored.
- Improved the visibility of certain UI elements.
- Updated translations.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1107
notes.notes:
- Fixed an intermittent issue where videos would not play.
- Fixed a crash that occurred when attempting to enter your own session from the multiplayer UI.
- Slightly reduced the weak spot effect of Radiant Nomad’s tier 5.
- Increased the total ammo of the Nebula MKV.
- Reduced Fatemaker’s manual cooldown time.
- Translation fixes.
- Adjusted alignment for certain UI elements.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1105
notes.notes:
- The failure count for customers in Sushi Showdown has been increased.
- The waiting time for customers in Sushi Showdown has been extended.
- Reload times for Radiant Nomad, Nebula MKV, Rapid Raptor, Outrawfire, and Tactical Viper have been significantly reduced.
- The Magazine Debuff effect for Viper's Gaze and Nebula MKV has been eased.
- Improved save/load stability

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1103
notes.notes:
Overall Difficulty Has Been Reduced!
- The armor of Ducalis and Hemycript has been reduced by about half.
- The Full Armored Ducalis that appeared in Difficulty Level 4 has been changed to Ducalis without a helmet.
- The base accuracy of the Outrawfire Rifle has been greatly increased.
- The base accuracy of the Skullcracker has been greatly increased.
- The Weak Spot Damage Bonus Modification of the Radiant Nomad has been increased.
- It has become easier to aim for the headshot of the Los Pollos Locos chicken.

- Fixed Japanese translation errors.
- Other minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1098
notes.notes:
- Introduced the beta version of in-game Voice Chat.
(Note: Multiplayer is not compatible with previous versions. Please update before playing. )

- Reduced the damage ratio of Sniper Rifle shots against reaper armor slightly.
- Significantly increased armor damage dealt by Sniper Rifle when hitting a reaper’s weak point.
- Corrected areas in the Lobby Restaurant where furniture could not be placed.
- Fixed an issue in the Lobby Restaurant where certain props placed on top of furniture would appear to float.
- Added an option to toggle Auto Path Assist on or off.
- Certain monsters will no longer spawn when the player’s level is low.
- Adjusted terrain in the Arcane Heart area of Wizard’s Tomb.
- Fixed an issue that could prevent progress in Sushi Showdown during multiplayer sessions.
- Fixed an issue in Los Pollos Locos where dropping raw chicken on the ground did not trigger a Tracker marker.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1094
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] In Sushi Showdown, the interval between each Time Reapers wave has been extended.
[*] In Sushi Showdown, the failure count for difficulty level 1 has been increased to 15.
[*] When the host’s character level is low, the difficulty has been adjusted to be somewhat easier.
[*] SFX has been adjusted overall so that the sound of reapers rushing in can be heard more clearly.
[*] The weak spot effect of Radiant Nomad’s Tier 5 modification has been strengthened.
[*] The design of the Objective Tracker has been changed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1088
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The tutorial section of Sushi Showdown has been updated.

[*] Fixed an issue where text overflowed in the Modification Widget.
[*] Fixed a bug with the Jukebox where songs would not play correctly.
[/list]
[b]Note[/b]: Multiplayer is not compatible with previous versions. Please update before playing.

- Fixed an issue where text would overflow in certain UI elements when it was too long
- Fixed a bug where furniture could be infinitely placed in the same spot in the restaurant
- Fixed terrain issues in Gingko Town

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1083
notes.notes:
- Fixed terrain issue in Gingko Town
- Adjusted UI display order of lobby furniture
- Fixed issue where contract rewards were not appearing

notes.notes:

- Fixed an issue where cutscenes would occasionally not play.
- Fixed an issue where gear modifications were sometimes not applied.
 Note: If you encounter issues with cutscene playback or gear modifications, please let us know.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1078
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where Time Reapers did not spawn during the escape phase in Gingko Town.
- Restored the recipe order in the lobby oven and fixed an issue where the selected pizza was not being made.
- Fixed an issue in Gingko Town where players could enter unintended locations, causing monsters to fail to detect them.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1077
notes.notes:

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1074
notes.notes: Hotfix: Disabled the voice chat feature that was unintentionally left enabled during testing. Hosts need to create rooms with the new version.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1073
notes.notes:
-In the lobby, pizzas are now sorted based on the toppings you own the most of.
-Added a Max FPS 90 option in the settings menu.
-Hemicrypt’s helmet defense has been significantly nerfed.
-Removed the item in the multiplayer window where all connections were displayed as “Critical.” Network -latency may still occur depending on the distance from the host. We will update soon to better indicate -possible latency issues, either by showing the host’s region or through other methods.

notes.title: Update Notes - Build v0.8.1072

notes.title: Pizza Bandit Demo Update v0.5.176
notes.notes:
[h3]Thank you for playing the "Pizza Bandit" demo and providing feedback. Over the past week, with almost daily updates, we'd like to share the modifications and improvements made.[/h3]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resolved issues with battles not functioning correctly due to terrain glitches.
[*] Fixed an error popping up when the game was initiated with a Steam VR device connected.
[*] Rectified abnormal path guidance after mission clearance in the restaurant.
[*] Addressed an issue where pressing ESC in the result window rendered the player's character invisible.
[*] Amended situations where players were unable to collect ammunition dropped by monsters in some cases.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enhanced clarity of mission instructions at the start of the Ginko Town mission.
[*] Increased the interaction scope for the refrigerator in the Restaurant mission.
[*] Corrected the overly dim view of the underground while spectating other players post-death. 
[/list]

[h3]Thank you for your significant interest and affection for "Pizza Bandit". Please add it to your wishlist.[/h3]
Pizza Bandit Devs
